scope: Read-only diagnosis of all 82944 existing locked Motion deletion scalar rows. No model, encoder or fitting calls.
analyses: Within each seed/episode/pool/horizon compare all three feature-error and position-error deletion orderings, with ties retained.
Measure feature-best set overlap and fractional task-optimal selection; report all pools and both-metrics-nonflat pools separately.
Compare feature-selected and cross-horizon-feature-selected task error to task-optimal and uniform task errors. Tied feature choices averaged exactly as parent.
Average pools/siblings then seeds inside each matched pair before paired 10000-draw bootstrap seed0; report each split/horizon, not pooled independent datasets.
Replay original compact oracle/baseline means from raw forks and independently reconstruct all new paired statistics.
limitations: Feature-optimal and task-optimal use revealed future targets; neither is a learned or deployable policy.
Position readout does not replace full-feature original requirements.
Raw scalar records identify within-pool ranking alignment, not vector residual causes or intrinsic task importance.
New 95% CIs are descriptive, unadjusted; original gates and original rejected outcome stay unchanged.
